context: Ren and Mei reflect on a documentary subject.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (運命/幸福/正義/才能/誤解) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あの人の人生、運命的だったね。
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle reflective delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、すごい才能の持ち主だった。
lines.en: Yeah, a person of great talent.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm reflective delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 才能ゆえに、誤解もされたよね。
lines.en: Because of the talent, he was misunderstood too.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 誤解されても、正義を曲げなかった。
lines.en: Even misunderstood, he didn't bend his sense of justice.
lines.style: admiring young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 本当の幸福を、見つけたのかな。
lines.en: I wonder if he found true happiness.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 運命を、自分で選んだ気がするよ。
lines.en: I feel he chose his own fate.
lines.style: thoughtful young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 正義と幸福、両方を生きたんだね。
lines.en: He lived both justice and happiness.
lines.style: moved woman voice, soft warm tender delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 誤解を越えた生き方、見習いたいな。
lines.en: I want to emulate his life beyond misunderstanding.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
